meta.bt: Tested out of sample (2020-21 to 2025-26, each season judged only on trends from the seasons before it): every side with a spot covering 5+ points above what its closing price implied (55%+ at -110) on 50+ games went 1,777-1,754 (50.3%, -4.9% return) against the closing line; 8+ points (58%+) on 100+ games, 117-145 (44.7%, -15.8% return); the first line alone, 1,142-1,102 (50.9%, -3.8% return). Totals the same way: 207-231 (47.3%, -11.2% return). Graded at each game's closing price: these trends have not beaten the closing line on games they never saw. Context, not a pick.
meta.bt_short: Out of sample (2020-21 to 2025-26, trends from earlier seasons only): sides whose spot ran 55%+ (5+ points over the price) on 50+ games went 1,777-1,754 (50.3%, -4.9% return), lost against the closing line.
meta.bt_held: None of the 49 spots the rule bet made money in 3+ later seasons with p < .05.
